input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and rollup/export) links are built from `BASE_URL = process.env.PUBLIC_URL ?? "http://localhost:3000"` in src/notifications/templates.ts. If `PUBLIC_URL` isn't set (or isn't set correctly) in the production environment, every generated link silently falls back to `http://localhost:3000`, which matches what you and your teammates are seeing. This likely needs the deployment config to set `PUBLIC_URL`, and/or the code should fail loudly instead of defaulting to localhost when it's missing in production.

input.title: Fix password reset emails linking to localhost
input.body: File: src/notifications/templates.ts. BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, which is being used to build the password reset link (and other links) sent in emails. Ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/set in the deployment environment, and consider making the code fail loudly or use a correct production default when PUBLIC_URL is missing, so reset links never resolve to localhost for real users.
